void handlePCIeDeviceGetRep(App& app, const crow::Request& req,
                            const std::shared_ptr<bmcweb::AsyncResp>& asyncResp,
                            const std::string& systemName,
                            const std::string& pcieDeviceId)
{
    BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG("REP: Received request for PCIeDevice {} in Chassis {}", pcieDeviceId, systemName);
    asyncResp->res.clearHeader(boost::beast::http::field::allow);
    if (!redfish::setUpRedfishRoute(app, req, asyncResp))
    {
        return;
    }

    if (!membersResponseGet(asyncResp, pcieDeviceId, "PCIeDeviceCollection"))
    {
        return;
    }
    // Call handlePCIeDeviceGet which already does getValidPCIeDevicePath
    // No need to duplicate the path lookup here
    redfish::handlePCIeDeviceGet(app, req, asyncResp, systemName, pcieDeviceId);
}

inline void afterGetValidPcieDevicePath(
    const std::shared_ptr<bmcweb::AsyncResp>& asyncResp,
    const std::string& pcieDeviceId, const std::string& pcieDevicePath,
    const std::string& service)
{
    addPCIeDeviceCommonProperties(asyncResp, pcieDeviceId);
    
    // Launch all D-Bus queries in parallel for better performance
    getPCIeDeviceAsset(asyncResp, pcieDevicePath, service);
    getPCIeDeviceState(asyncResp, pcieDevicePath, service);
    getPCIeDeviceHealth(asyncResp, pcieDevicePath, service);
    
    // REP: Get Status (State/Health) from Common.Status interface
    sdbusplus::asio::getAllProperties(
        *crow::connections::systemBus, service, pcieDevicePath,
        "xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Status",
        [asyncResp](const boost::system::error_code& ec,
                    const dbus::utility::DBusPropertiesMap& statusList) {
            if (ec)
            {
                // Non-critical, some devices may not have this interface
                BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG("Status interface not available: {}", ec);
                return;
            }
            const std::string* state = nullptr;
            const std::string* health = nullptr;
            const bool success = sdbusplus::unpackPropertiesNoThrow(
                dbus_utils::UnpackErrorPrinter(), statusList, 
                "State", state, "Health", health);
            if (success)
            {
                if (state != nullptr)
                {
                    asyncResp->res.jsonValue["Status"]["State"] = *state;
                }
                if (health != nullptr)
                {
                    asyncResp->res.jsonValue["Status"]["Health"] = *health;
                }
            }
        });
    
    // REP: Get AssetTag
    sdbusplus::asio::getProperty<std::string>(
        *crow::connections::systemBus, service, pcieDevicePath,
        "xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.AssetTag", "AssetTag",
        [asyncResp](const boost::system::error_code& ec,
                    const std::string& property) {
            if (!ec)
            {
                asyncResp->res.jsonValue["AssetTag"] = property;
            }
            // Non-critical if not present
        });
    
    getPCIeDeviceProperties(
        asyncResp, pcieDevicePath, service,
        std::bind_front(addPCIeDeviceProperties, asyncResp, pcieDeviceId));
    getPCIeDeviceSlotPath(
        pcieDevicePath, asyncResp,
        std::bind_front(afterGetPCIeDeviceSlotPath, asyncResp));
}
